description: CIGRE Technical Brochure 575, Benchmark Systems for Network Integration of Renewable and Distributed Energy Resources, defines a set of reference electricity networks that are representative of real integration challenges, so that methods and smart grid technologies for connecting distributed energy resources can be compared on a common platform. It was published in 2014 by CIGRE, the international council on large electric systems, from the work of Task Force C6.04 of Study Committee C6 on active distribution systems and distributed energy resources. Coverage: generic, non-geographic benchmark networks discussed in detail across 119 pages; the pandapower library implements high-voltage, medium-voltage and low-voltage versions from the brochure, with optional photovoltaic, wind and other DER placements for the medium-voltage grid taken from a CIGRE case study. Format and access: a 1 MB PDF from eCIGRE, free to CIGRE members and 220 euros for non-members, also summarised in Electra 273 (2014); machine-readable versions exist in tools such as pandapower (create_cigre_network_hv, _mv and _lv). Licence: CIGRE copyright; permission to reuse the contents must be requested. Caveats: the brochure itself was not read (paywalled), so network sizes and parameters are not given here, and implementations in software may differ in detail from the brochure. Simulation uses: standard test systems for power flow, hosting capacity, DER control, resilience and optimisation studies of distribution grids. Related records: pandapower (model-pandapower) ships ready-to-use versions of these networks.
